prediction_policy: Sixteen frozen recorded queries; no prediction interpolation or new inference.
evaluation_scope: Development-exposed EvTTC transfer study. Scalar scenario TTC, not per-object ground truth.
display_policy: Camera playback swaps channels 0 and 2 to match the publisher visualization; the stored channel encoding is not declared in the HDF5 metadata. Model input crops preserve the frozen runtime channel order. RGB and events remain in separate camera coordinate systems. Events show preceding half-open 100 ms windows. Movie uses 20 Hz CFR; sidecar preserves each exact sensor timestamp. Input channels are preprocessing measurements, not learned activations.
